issue.title: just check fails at lint (pyscripts): visual-maintenance tool references violate closer-dir rule
issue.description:
`just check` fails on a clean tree at `lint (pyscripts)` before reaching pytest.
`just _lint-pyscripts` runs `tools/pyscripts-260801` and emits Rule 2
closer-dir errors for the visual-maintenance tool references:

- `tools/fix_tui_screenshots` referenced by
  `tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_capture.py`,
  `tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_maintenance_cli.py`, and
  `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_fix_tui_screenshots.py`, but
  `tests/ace/tui/tools/` exists
- `tools/run_pytest` referenced by nine `_visual_maintenance*.py` modules,
  but `tests/ace/tui/tools/` exists
- `tools/render_visual_snapshot_failure_report` referenced by
  `tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_maintenance_manifest.py`, but
  `tests/ace/tui/tools/` exists

Observed while verifying an unrelated Beads navigation split; the working
tree change touches only `beads_navigation*.py` and one Beads test file.

---

## CI failure

- **Node:** `tools/pyscripts-260801::Rule 2 visual-maintenance closer-dir references`

Deterministic static lint failure, not a flake: reproduced on the clean
tree via `git stash -u` (baseline `just _lint-pyscripts` exits 1 with the
identical Rule 2 lines), then restored with `git stash pop`. `just check`
stops at the lint stage, so no pytest lane runs.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static lint failure reproduced on the clean tree via git stash (identical Rule 2 output); just check stops before pytest.
